Summary

Ceva licenses semiconductor and software IP. The central question is whether connectivity and edge-AI licensing converts into durable royalties and covers engineering costs after economic compensation. The reviewed V3 bear/base/bull cases are $5.742889/$12.981785/$27.590498 per share under stated assumptions; none is a current target.

简体中文

Ceva 授权半导体与软件知识产权。核心问题是连接及边缘 AI 授权能否转为持续版税，并在计入经济薪酬后覆盖研发成本。已复核 V3 熊／基准／牛条件值为每股 5.742889／12.981785／27.590498 美元，均不是当前目标价。

Scope

June 30, 2026 capital/share and discount anchor; October 19, 2026 information; retrospective conditional operating-value study. The June filing and subsequent guidance were published after June 30. These later-known inputs cannot support an ex-ante June backtest. Entering a current quote does not refresh capital, shares or claims.

简体中文

2026 年六月三十日资本、股数及折现起点；2026 年十月十九日信息；回溯性条件经营价值研究。六月申报及后续指引均在六月三十日后公布，因此不能用于当时可获得信息的历史回测。输入现价不会更新资本、股数或请求权。

Business

Wireless connectivity, sensing/audio/DSP and edge-AI IP produce license, engineering/support and shipment-based royalty revenue. Design wins can precede production by years or never reach volume. Device units, license signings, license revenue and royalties are different measures.

简体中文

无线连接、感知／音频／DSP 及边缘 AI 知识产权带来授权、工程／支持及按出货计提的版税收入。设计采用可能多年后才量产，也可能未形成规模。设备数量、签约、授权收入及版税是不同指标。

Segment bridge

FY2025 licensing and related revenue was $63.595m and royalties $46.003m, totaling $109.598m. The filing reports $49.652m point-in-time licensing and $13.943m over-time licensing. Smart sensing is not an audited AI-only segment. China accounted for $67.895m of revenue; customer-location revenue is not final-consumer geography.

简体中文

FY2025 授权及相关收入 63.595 百万美元，版税 46.003，合计 109.598。申报中时点确认授权为 49.652，期间确认授权为 13.943。智能感知不是经审计的独立 AI 分部。中国客户收入为 67.895；客户所在地不等于最终消费者所在地。

Recent quarter

H1 2026 revenue was $56.057m, licensing $36.041m and royalties $20.016m; GAAP EBIT was −$7.161m. CFO $0.940m less PPE purchases $2.949m was −$2.009m. Q2 revenue was $29.033m, including $18.221m licensing and $10.812m royalties. Shipment growth alone does not establish royalty growth.

简体中文

2026 上半年收入 56.057 百万美元，其中授权 36.041、版税 20.016；GAAP 营业亏损 7.161。经营现金流 0.940 减物业设备购置 2.949 等于负 2.009。第二季收入 29.033，包括授权 18.221 及版税 10.812。出货增长本身不能证明版税增长。

History

Ten annual observations span FY2016–2025: revenue rises from $72.653m to $109.598m while GAAP EBIT moves from $14.386m profit to $11.346m loss. Historical margins do not establish future recovery. FY2025 R&D was $74.833m and SBC $19.796m. Exact FY2017 common shares are corrected to 22.064007m.

简体中文

十年历史覆盖 FY2016–2025：收入从 72.653 增至 109.598 百万美元，GAAP 营业利润由 14.386 转为亏损 11.346。历史利润率不能证明未来复苏。FY2025 研发 74.833，股权薪酬 19.796。FY2017 时点普通股数已修正为 22.064007 百万股。

Accounting

ASC606 adoption in 2018 is a break; FY2016–2017 is not retrospectively normalized. FY2021–2023 revenue and EBIT are restated continuing operations following Intrinsix disposal, while net income and total CFO are consolidated. Continuing CFO and D&A are separately reconciled; a continuing PPE-capex split is unavailable.

简体中文

2018 年采用 ASC606 构成会计断点，FY2016–2017 未追溯统一。Intrinsix 出售后 FY2021–2023 收入和营业利润按持续经营重述，净利润及总经营现金流仍为合并口径。持续经营现金流及折旧摊销已另行对账；持续经营物业设备资本开支拆分未知。

Vintages

FY2021–2023 continuing CFO is $28.896m/$10.040m/−$4.096m, versus consolidated $25.804m/$6.924m/−$6.331m. Continuing D&A is $5.728m/$5.356m/$3.802m. Later recasts do not make the ten-year series constant perimeter. Unknown historical fields remain null.

简体中文

FY2021–2023 持续经营现金流为 28.896／10.040／负 4.096 百万美元，合并口径为 25.804／6.924／负 6.331；持续经营折旧摊销为 5.728／5.356／3.802。后期重述不使十年数据成为恒定业务范围序列。未知字段保留空值。

Cash conversion

Historical cash flow is CFO less property-and-equipment purchases only, not comprehensive free cash flow or unlevered FCFF. Under nonnegative component PPE purchases, FY2021–2023 continuing CFO less PPE is bounded at $26.703–28.896m, $6.541–10.040m and −$6.980 to −$4.096m. No exact continuing capex split is fabricated. FY2018 separately purchased $1.960m intangibles, reducing CFO less PPE $5.293m to $3.333m after those intangibles.

简体中文

历史现金流只表示经营现金流减物业设备购置，不是扣除全部投资的自由现金流或无杠杆 FCFF。假设各业务购置非负，FY2021–2023 持续经营现金流减物业设备的区间为 26.703–28.896、6.541–10.040、负 6.980 至负 4.096 百万美元；未编造准确拆分。FY2018 另购无形资产 1.960，扣物业设备后的 5.293 再扣该项后为 3.333。

Guidance

The management scorecard covers nine forecast quarters from Q2 2024 through Q2 2026, with 27 comparisons: revenue, GAAP operating expenses and approximate GAAP gross margin. Revenue was twice above range, six times within and once below. Q1 2025 revenue of $24.245m missed $25.5–27.5m guidance.

简体中文

管理层记录涵盖 2024 第二季至 2026 第二季九个预测季度，共 27 项对比：收入、GAAP 营业费用及近似 GAAP 毛利率。收入两次高于区间、六次区间内、一次低于区间。2025 第一季收入 24.245 百万美元，低于 25.5–27.5 指引。

Guidance quality

Approximate gross-margin guidance is not a precise beat/miss interval; higher operating expense is not inherently favorable. Q4 actuals may be derived as full-year less nine months. FY2025 growth was 2.486%, below the original 7–11% outlook and consistent with revised low-single-digit commentary. No EPS scorecard or full Q&A/interview coverage is claimed.

简体中文

近似毛利率指引不构成精确超预期区间，营业费用更高也不必然有利。第四季实际值可能由全年减前九个月得到。FY2025 增长 2.486%，低于最初 7–11% 展望，符合后来低个位数表述。未声称建立 EPS 记录或覆盖完整问答／访谈。

Outlook

FY2026 management revenue-growth guidance progressed from 8–12% in February to 12% in May and 13–15% in August, implying $123.84574–126.03770m on the exact FY2025 base. Q3 revenue guidance is $30.5–34.5m. FY2026 and Q3 remain unscored because actuals were unavailable at the cutoff.

简体中文

FY2026 管理层收入增长指引由二月 8–12%，升至五月 12%，再升至八月 13–15%；以准确 FY2025 基数计算为 123.84574–126.03770 百万美元。第三季收入指引为 30.5–34.5。截止时未有第三季及全年实际值，因此不计入成绩。

Acquisitions

Intrinsix was acquired in 2021 and sold in October 2023. Its operating-history recast and acquisition/divestiture investing cash flows cannot be substituted for continuing PPE purchases. Future acquisitions, distributions and financing are not included in the funding-capacity proxy.

简体中文

Intrinsix 于 2021 年收购、2023 年十月出售。其经营历史重述及收购／出售投资现金流不能替代持续经营物业设备购置。资金承受能力代理值不包含未来收购、分配及融资。

Profitability

FY2026 GAAP operating-margin assumptions are −12%/−6%/−3% for bear/base/bull, moving linearly to 6%/18%/28% by FY2035. H2 GAAP EBIT equals full-year modeled EBIT minus reported H1 EBIT. Future SBC and R&D remain expensed. Bull recovery requires substantially stronger operating leverage than recent results.

简体中文

熊／基准／牛 FY2026 GAAP 营业利润率假设为负 12%／负 6%／负 3%，线性改善至 FY2035 的 6%／18%／28%。下半年 GAAP 营业利润等于模型全年减已报上半年。未来股权薪酬及研发保留为费用。牛情景需要显著强于近期的经营杠杆。

Growth

FY2026 licensing/royalty assumptions are $70m/$44m bear, $76m/$49m base and $80m/$51m bull. Nine subsequent licensing and royalty growth rates are separately specified in the source inputs. Base begins near management guidance; bear misses and bull exceeds it. These are named analyst scenarios without probabilities, not estimated expected outcomes.

简体中文

FY2026 授权／版税假设为熊 70／44、基准 76／49、牛 80／51 百万美元；之后九年两条增长路径在输入中单列。基准接近管理层指引，熊低于、牛高于指引。这些是无概率的命名分析情景，不是预期结果估计。

Capital

June liquid assets total $220.720m: cash $44.301m, deposits $5.148m and marketable debt securities $171.271m. They are not all bank cash or risk-free immediately distributable funds. Default reserve is $30m; subtract net severance $0.217m and other noncurrent accruals $1.072m. No interest-bearing borrowing is listed in this bridge.

简体中文

六月流动金融资产共 220.720 百万美元：现金 44.301、存款 5.148、可出售债务证券 171.271。它们不全是银行现金，也不保证无风险且可立即分配。默认经营预留 30，扣净遣散负债 0.217 及其他非流动应计 1.072。桥接未列有息借款。

Claims

Use 28.137917m June 30 legal common shares plus the disclosed 1.845728m unvested RSU/PSU aggregate. H1/Q2 weighted EPS shares 27.838m/27.996m and later August 4 common shares 28.154072m are not substitutes. Operating leases total $17.424m; lease expense stays in EBIT and leases are not deducted again.

简体中文

采用六月三十日法定普通股 28.137917 百万及已披露未归属 RSU／PSU 合计 1.845728 百万。上半年／第二季 EPS 加权股数 27.838／27.996 及八月四日普通股 28.154072 均不能替代。经营租赁共 17.424 百万美元，租赁费用保留在营业利润内，不重复扣负债。

Awards

The aggregate award reserve is not a proven maximum PSU payout; 234,617 maximum 2026 PSU units are disclosed separately without a full grant reconciliation. Add back only $28.506m unrecognized existing-award expense, allocated $9.502m to H2 2026 and $19.004m to 2027 as an analyst timing assumption. Future awards remain cash-replacement compensation in margins.

简体中文

合计奖励预留不是已证实的 PSU 最高支付；另披露 2026 PSU 上限 234,617 单位，但未完成逐笔授予对账。只加回现有奖励未确认费用 28.506 百万美元，分析假设分配至 2026 下半年 9.502、2027 年 19.004。未来奖励仍按现金替代薪酬计入利润率。

Financing

Options use an endogenous intrinsic-exercise approximation for 30,025 outstanding options at a $20.91 weighted strike. Only 19,279 were exercisable and remaining life averaged 4.4 years. The model omits time value and vesting timing; out-of-money options need not be worthless. It is not exact option-adjusted fair value.

简体中文

对 30,025 份未行使期权采用内生内在价值行权近似，加权行权价 20.91 美元；其中仅 19,279 可行权，平均剩余期限 4.4 年。模型未计时间价值及归属时点，价外期权不必然无价值。这不是精确的期权调整公允价值。

Funding

Funding capacity equals opening liquid assets plus cumulative modeled FCFF after future-SBC cash replacement. Minimums are $169.060743m/$215.343842m/$220.720000m, above the assumed $30m reserve. This is a stress proxy, not forecast bank cash, and excludes interest income, acquisitions, distributions, financing and intra-period cash troughs.

简体中文

资金承受能力等于期初流动资产加累计模型 FCFF，未来股权薪酬按现金替代扣除。最低值为 169.060743／215.343842／220.720000 百万美元，均高于假设预留 30。这是压力代理指标而非银行现金预测，未包含利息收入、收购、分配、融资及期间内低谷。

Tax

Both explicit and terminal cash tax are max(0, 20% of economic EBIT, 3% of revenue). V3 repairs the prior omission of the terminal revenue floor. Of June liquidity, $122.7m was abroad; zero access tax is conditional, not a verified exemption. A dollar offshore-tax haircut is editable separately.

简体中文

显性期及终值现金税均取零、经济营业利润 20%、收入 3% 中最大值。V3 修复此前终值遗漏收入税底线的问题。六月流动资产有 122.7 百万美元在境外，零取得税只是条件假设，非已证实免税；可另编辑美元计境外税折减。

Wacc

Bear/base/bull WACC is 13%/11%/10%; perpetual growth is 2%/2.5%/3%. These are uncalibrated analyst parameters, not measured market rates or scenario probabilities. Cash flows are discounted from June 30 at 0.5, 1.5, …, 9.5 years; reported H1 cash flow is not discounted again.

简体中文

熊／基准／牛 WACC 为 13%／11%／10%，永续增长 2%／2.5%／3%。这些是未经统计校准的分析参数，不是实测市场利率或情景概率。现金流从六月三十日起按 0.5、1.5 至 9.5 年折现，不重复折现已报上半年现金流。

Terminal

Explicit reinvestment is PPE capex 3.5% minus D&A 3% of revenue plus 18% of incremental full-year revenue (halved in H2 2026). Terminal reinvestment instead uses taxed NOPAT × growth / 25% incremental ROIC; this is a visible regime change, not a proven maintenance-capital requirement. Terminal PV is 79.38% of base EV and 76.39% of bull EV. Bear EV is negative, so its terminal/EV ratio is not meaningful.

简体中文

显性期再投资为收入 3.5% 物业设备资本开支减 3% 折旧摊销，加全年收入增量的 18%（2026 下半年减半）。终值改用税后营业利润×增长率÷25% 增量 ROIC，属于明确的机制切换，非已证实维护资本需求。终值占基准 EV 79.38%、牛 76.39%；熊 EV 为负，该比例无经济解释意义。

Uncertainty

Default growth, margin recovery, taxes, working capital, reserve, 25% terminal incremental ROIC, existing-award runoff and foreign-cash access are explicit assumptions. Bear/base/bull are not probabilities, a confidence interval or an expected-return distribution. The frozen package includes 80 sensitivity rows, including offshore haircuts and 1.25×/1.5× aggregate-award stresses.

简体中文

默认增长、利润恢复、税率、营运资本、现金预留、25% 终值增量 ROIC、现有奖励摊销及境外资金可用性均为明确假设。熊／基准／牛不是概率、置信区间或预期回报分布。冻结包包含 80 行敏感性，包括境外折减及 1.25／1.5 倍奖励合计压力。

Claim limits

The default award multiplier is 1×; editable multipliers up to 2× are diagnostic stress choices, not legal maximum obligations. Unknown inputs remain unknown and may suppress allocation. Additional PSU/option valuation, current capital events and tax access evidence are needed before a current-value claim.

简体中文

默认奖励乘数为 1 倍，最多可编辑至 2 倍仅为压力诊断，不是法定最高义务。未知输入保持未知，可能关闭股权分配输出。提出当前价值主张前，仍需进一步 PSU／期权估值、最新资本事项及资金取得税证据。

Audit

Final independent V3 re-review passed 437 additional assertions after 364 replay and 94 source/history/bridge assertions in the earlier review. It recomputed corrected cases and all 80 sensitivities and checked preservation hashes. Author V3 checks total 160. Counts are assertions, not independent observations or probability of accuracy; adapter and deployment require their own checks.

简体中文

最终独立 V3 复核通过新增 437 项断言，此前有 364 项重算及 94 项来源／历史／桥接断言；复算修正情景及全部 80 行敏感性并核对保全哈希。作者 V3 检查共 160 项。数量是断言数，不是独立观察数或准确率；适配及部署需另检验。

Source limits

Only derived financial facts, original analysis and reproducibility data are packaged. Primary filings and prepared remarks are linked with retained hashes; no raw filing, PDF or transcript text is redistributed. Prepared remarks do not establish comprehensive Q&A or interview coverage, and annual source tracing is not a financial-statement audit.

简体中文

仅打包派生财务事实、原创分析及重现数据。原始申报和预备发言以链接及哈希列示，不再分发申报、PDF 或逐字稿正文。预备发言不代表完整问答或访谈覆盖，年度来源追溯不等于财务报表审计。

Publication gates

This bounded retrospective study can be reviewed in the workspace. Current target, upside, expected return, recommendation, ranking and historical-backtest eligibility remain false. June capital plus October information must not be presented as a contemporaneous investable signal. A quote or scenario edit cannot clear those gates.

简体中文

可在工作区复核这项有界回溯研究。当前目标价、上涨空间、预期回报、建议、排名及历史回测资格均保持关闭。六月资本配十月信息不能展示为当时可投资信号；输入现价或编辑情景不能解除限制。
